newsitem.title: USA: OUTBOARD MARINE REVIEWING GREENMARINE OFFER.
newsitem.headline: OUTBOARD MARINE REVIEWING GREENMARINE OFFER.

text.p: Outboard Marine Corp said Monday it is reviewing an $18 a share buyout proposal by Greenmarine Acquisition Corp.
Greenmarine, an affiliate of Greenway Partners, launched a tender offer for all of Outboard Marine's common stock on August 8, 1997.

The company also said it had exercised its right to request Detroit Diesel Corp to extend its $16 a share tender offer for 13,842,619 shares of Outboard Marine's common stock for 10 business days beyond the original expiration date of midnight on August 11, 1997. As a result, the tender offer will be effective until 1200 midnight, New York City time, on August 25, 1997.
Shares of Outboard Marine, which makes and markets marine engines, boats and accessories, closed up 3/16 to 17-15/16.
